launcher.label: Got a question?
launcher.aria: Open the chat with Laura, AI assistant

disclosure: Laura is an AI assistant. Her answers may be incomplete — for anything contractual, talk to the team.

greeting.first: Hi! I'm Laura. Tell me what brings you here — I'll answer right away, and if I don't know, I'll say so.
greeting.firstConcrete: Hi, I'm Laura. In 30 seconds I can show you what BellumAI actually changes in your prospecting — or hand you the demo right away.
greeting.return: Good to see you again. You've been here before — what can I answer today?
greeting.exit: Heading off? One quick question before you go?

proactive.home: Want to know what BellumAI actually changes for an IT services firm? I can sum it up in three lines.
proactive.pricing: A question about credits, or about which plan fits your team? I can help you choose.
proactive.product: Looking for a specific capability? Tell me which one and I'll tell you where it stands.
proactive.useCases: Want to see how this plays out on a case close to yours? Tell me about your setup.
proactive.demo: The demo runs on fictional accounts, no sign-up needed. Any question before you dive in?
proactive.beta: Hesitating about applying to the beta programme? I can tell you what it involves.
proactive.about: A question about the team, or about how the product is built?
proactive.webinar: Want to know what will be shown during the session? I can tell you.

prefill.withheld: Your name and what you typed stay right here — nothing else leaves.

errors.not_configured: The chat isn't available right now. Write to us directly — we answer fast.
errors.empty: I didn't get anything — try again?
errors.too_long: Your message is too long for me. Could you sum it up in a few lines?
errors.rate_limited: We've exchanged a lot in this session. Come back in a few minutes, or write to the team directly.
errors.injection: I can't do that. I can tell you about the product, pricing or the demo though.
errors.unavailable: I can't answer right now. Try again, or write to the team.

nudge.soft: I'll let you think. If you want, just tell me what's blocking you most right now.
nudge.last: I'll leave you to it. I'm here if it comes back.
